info.name: Candidate Service API
info.description:
Manual API test collection for candidate-service (all endpoints, happy and error paths).

How to use:
1. Start the app (see README).
2. Run **0. Login → Sign in** with your recruiter username and password, then copy `accessToken` from the response into the collection variable `token`.
3. Every request uses that token (collection-level Bearer auth).

Note: requests use fixed test emails (e.g. ananya@test.com) and fixed ids in URLs (e.g. /candidates/1). Adjust the ids to the candidates created in your run. Results were tracked in a test tracker.

item.name: Sign in (copy accessToken into the 'token' variable)
Create - invalid fields -> 400 with field errors
Get A by id -> 200 full details
Search - page past the end -> empty
